0022600113.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-2, on a two-game losing streak) are 12th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and will play their first home game of the season after losing their opener on the road. The Indiana Pacers (1-1) sit 3rd in the Central, 1 game back, and are 9th in the East after winning their road game and losing their most recent one. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), with Aaron Nesmith listed as day-to-day with a hamstring strain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the season series 1-2, including a 123-94 loss in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026.
